notes: Connection badge bug fix + corner status box + dashboard day-summary cards (1.11.10): GET /api/calendar/status now ships the full uid_map + orphaned box ids under programme, and the frontend stamps them onto every box in allBoxes() (CAL_LINKS, applied in loadAll before first render and before every re-render after sync/reconnect) — boxConnected() finally sees the real link data, fixing the reported 'no badge anywhere after sync' bug. The inline «متصل» badge is replaced by ONE shared corner status box in the card's physical top-right corner (CSS right, same in RTL/LTR): «در تقویم ✓» when connected, «در تقویم نیست» when disconnected; same helper in dashboard/assignment/backlog cards and in the archive + review-past tables (new first «تقویم» column); reserved top strip keeps content clear of it; edit-modal status line unchanged. Two summary cards above the daily programme («جزئیات امروز» + «روز بعد»): total/class/general/test/study hours + box count, computed at render time from the main programme data (study-day 03:30 boundary, boxActivityType shared mapping, overnight +24h, no stored duplicate), «بدون برنامه» when tomorrow is empty, and a «مشاهده برنامه کامل در تقویم» button that opens the calendar tab on tomorrow's date via the shared {jy, jm} view + selectedDay (no new route). No change to merge/link logic, sync, menu, or reconnect flow.
